title: Dexter Morgan vs James Doakes Analyzed Like Chess | Dexter

source_quality.source_metadata_note: Nineteen ordinary public Clip.cafe clips measured native 1920x1080 (23.976 fps), conformed without resize to 30fps. Eleven selected Dexter-Doakes conversations from Seasons 1-2, authentic cast, no burned captions, broadcaster logo or third-party watermark seen in reviewed frames. Original public clips are compressed (about 0.25-1.1 Mb/s video); facial detail is softer than a disc master. Accepted for a private YouTube-check candidate, not claimed maximum-source quality.

outro_summary: Doakes is the only colleague who never buys the smile, and Dexter spends two seasons managing a man who is right about him. The lab jokes become a dossier, the dossier becomes a cage, and the cage becomes the most honest room either of them has ever sat in. Eleven exchanges, thirty-two decisions, and one detective who was never wrong.
